name: Tata Steel Ltd
title: Tata Steel Ltd - 500470 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: India EBITDA up 17% to Rs 34,272 cr at 24% margin; 1QFY27 India realisations guided ~Rs 6,000/t higher QoQ, but Netherlands coke-oven closure and UK grid delay add execution risk.

capex.peers_comment: Management said competitors are adding capacity aggressively; did not comment on specifics beyond that.
capex.quote: we intend to increase the same in FY2027 to around Rs 20,000 crores of which more than 60% will be spend in India

triggers.label: India 1QFY27 realisation +Rs 6,000/t QoQ
triggers.quote: in India we expect 1Q to be about Rs. 6,000 /t higher than 4Q

triggers.label: FY27 capex raised to ~Rs 20,000 cr
triggers.quote: we intend to increase the same in FY2027 to around Rs 20,000 crores of which more than 60% will be spend in India

triggers.label: UK safeguard tariff 25%→50%, quotas -60%
triggers.quote: the revised safeguard regime proposes a ~60% reduction in import quotas alongside an increase in tariffs from 25% to 50%

triggers.label: UK grid delay adds 6-8 months
triggers.quote: National Grid has formally alerted to us that their connectivity project is delayed

triggers.label: Netherlands coke ovens to close; permit revocation letter
triggers.quote: we have received a letter post the Balance Sheet date from the local environment agencies regarding their intent to revoke permits without any specifics
triggers.highlight: intent to revoke permits without any specifics

guidance.quote: The volume will be at least 2 million tons better in this financial year compared to the previous financial year
In FY2027 we are aiming to achieve cost transformation related savings of ~Rs 7,100 crores vs. FY2026 levels
we intend to increase the same in FY2027 to around Rs 20,000 crores of which more than 60% will be spend in India
in UK we expect it to be about £80/t higher in 1Q compared to 4Q
we hope to be EBITDA positive during this year
between July and September, we should be able to get the FID and once we get the FID, the target date is somewhere around 2029-30
